stemMd: Two forces of 6 N east and 8 N north act on a point. What is the magnitude of their resultant?
explanationMd: The forces are perpendicular, so their vector sum has magnitude √(6² + 8²) = 10 N. Adding magnitudes would be valid only if they pointed in the same direction. The resultant lies northeast.

distractorRationale.a: This adds magnitudes as if the forces were parallel.
distractorRationale.d: This subtracts magnitudes as if they were opposite.
distractorRationale.c: Multiplying force magnitudes does not give a resultant force.
distractorRationale.b: This is the sum of squares before taking the square root.
